sources.snippet: FastEmbed is a lightweight, fast, Python library built for embedding generation. We support popular text models. Please open a GitHub issue if you want us to add a new model. The default text embedding (TextEmbedding) model is Flag Embedding, presented in the MTEB leaderboard. It supports "query" and "passage" prefixes for the input text.
